Maatadi

Learn to speak and understand Kannada. Meanings and pronunciation are shown in Malayalam. Just listen, repeat, and talk.

Your device has no Kannada voice, so audio may sound wrong. On Android or Chrome, install Kannada text-to-speech in your system settings.

How to practise: play a phrase, say it out loud three times, then mark it. Use the slow button for hard words. Ten minutes a day works better than one long session.
